themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and execute workflows with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often by suggesting code snippets or identifying vulnerabilities.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to aid in various stages of research, from data collection to analysis and insight generation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to generate artificial users or data for testing and research purposes, simulating real user behavior.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in rapid information processing.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly assist designers and researchers in their creative and analytical processes, from ideation to iteration.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to automate or enhance the process of evaluating the ease of use and user-friendliness of products and services.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating software testing processes, improving efficiency, coverage, and accuracy in quality assurance.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates user interactions, behaviors, and the impact of AI chatbots in various contexts, including their potential for misinformation or cognitive effects.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Analyzes how AI is affecting jobs, employment, and the overall labor market, including concerns about job displacement and the need for retraining.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
